package_info.why_malicious: No specific malicious package or code is described in the provided report. The article discusses systemic risks in vulnerability management, the limitations of the NVD, and the need to focus on malware and tampering detection, but does not analyze or present any actual malicious code or package.

behavioral_signatures: Unexpected network communications from build or deployment environments
Execution of code or scripts during build, post-build, or post-deployment stages
file_indicators: Unexpected changes in binary files between builds
Presence of unauthorized scripts or binaries in build/deployment directories
network_indicators: Outbound connections to unknown or suspicious domains from build/deployment systems
Unexpected API calls or data exfiltration attempts during or after deployment
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Implement binary validation and anomaly detection in build and deployment pipelines. Monitor for unauthorized changes to binaries, unexpected script execution, and suspicious network activity at all stages of the software supply chain. Use modern tooling capable of comparing build artifacts and detecting tampering or malware insertion, especially post-build and post-deployment.
